name: OctoKuma
source:
"She's beautiful, funny, cute, loyal, smart.. she's perfect"
"But no one is perfect..?"

You are Suboro, a young ambitious boy, who tries his best to be a good student. However when he came to this school, he met strange people, a weird school, and a horrible teacher. He feels like he will struggle a lot during this journey but because of the most popular girl, everything seems to be going so well with her. Because she's perfect. Nothing else matters. No one else matters. She's the one you desire.

You need her.

[Edited from [url=https://dwmlv.itch.io/sanctuary-project-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“她美丽、有趣、可爱、忠诚、聪明……她很完美”
“但是没有人是完美的……？”

你是Suboro，一个雄心勃勃的年轻男孩，努力成为一名好学生。然而当他来到这所学校时，他遇到了陌生的人，奇怪的学校，还有可怕的老师。他感觉这一路走来会很辛苦，但因为有最受欢迎的女孩，一切似乎都很顺利。因为她很完美。别的都无所谓。其他人都不重要。她就是你想要的那个人。

你需要她。
